title: Best Restaurants & Cuisines
description: World cuisines, famous restaurants, and the techniques behind them.

questions.prompt: A classic Neapolitan pizza Margherita is topped with tomato, fresh basil, and which cheese — together echoing the colors of the Italian flag?
questions.explanation: Pizza Margherita pairs tomato (red), mozzarella (white), and basil (green) to evoke the Italian flag; by popular legend it was named in 1889 for Queen Margherita of Savoy during her visit to Naples (Wikipedia: 'Pizza Margherita').

questions.prompt: Which Japanese dish is built around vinegared rice combined with ingredients such as raw fish, egg, or vegetables?
questions.explanation: Sushi is defined by its seasoned, vinegared rice (shari) rather than by raw fish — seafood served on its own without the rice is sashimi, not sushi (Wikipedia: 'Sushi').

questions.prompt: Mole poblano, the celebrated sauce from the Mexican state of Puebla, gets its dark color and depth from dried chiles blended with which ingredient?
questions.explanation: Mole poblano is a dark red-brown sauce from Puebla made by blending dried chiles (such as ancho) with chocolate, plus nuts, seeds, and spices (MasterClass: 'How to Make Mexican Mole Poblano').

questions.prompt: Pad thai was promoted as a national dish during a late-1930s nationalist campaign led by which Thai prime minister, in part to curb the country's rice consumption?
questions.explanation: To reduce wartime rice consumption and forge a modern Thai identity, the government of Prime Minister Plaek Phibunsongkhram promoted rice-noodle dishes in the late 1930s and 1940s, helping establish pad thai as one of Thailand's national dishes (Wikipedia: 'Pad thai').
